content.short: EpicApes is a full-fledged f2p & p2e idle game where your time and effort can be turned into real money!
content.description: EpicApes is a cutting-edge mini game that fuses idle adventures with blockchain technology. Players embark on a thrilling journey to battle enemies, upgrade their characters, complete missions, and earn valuable rewards. Compete in the arena, team up with friends, and collect cash tokens to unlock tokens airdrop, which can be traded on exchanges! 🚀💰 Free to Play! Accessible to everyone, with no entry fees or requirements. Enhance your character’s performance by upgrading levels and equipment to defeat enemies.
content.meta: Find out about EpicApes on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
